title: Signature What the Singularity Index is
description: The Signature-original design of this capability, authored as a new engineering proposal rather than a survey of existing systems. The Signature design introduces Index Cartography: each participating index publishes a signed coverage map describing what it holds at what granularity, and the singularity layer plans queries from those maps alone — never by crawling the indexes themselves. Coverage maps are measured, not claimed, by a prober that spot-checks them. An original engineering proposal, not a description of existing systems. This record covers what the Singularity Index is: A coverage-map store describing participating indexes; a query planner that selects indexes per question; per-index translators; a result merger with provenance.
